Name: OD's Junimo Krobus
Author: ODMods
Description:
[size=6]OD's Junimo Krobus[/size]

Makes Krobus turn into a Junimo.
[size=5]
Installation[/size]

1. Install SMAPI (https://smapi.io).
2. Install Content Patcher (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).
3. Download this mod and unzip it into your `Stardew Valley/Mods` folder.
4. Launch the game via SMAPI.

[size=5]Requirements[/size]

[size=3]SMAPI[/size]
[size=3]Content Patcher[/size]
[size=3]OD's Krobus Shadow Fix[/size]
